name: Orchard Candle — Fig, Cedar & Black Tea
description: A soy and coconut wax candle poured into a matte oatmeal stoneware cup, with a scent that opens on green fig and settles into cedarwood and black tea. The throw is quiet rather than sweet, so it reads as calm and clean in a small room. The cup is made to be kept and reused for pens or a single stem once the wax is gone.
details: 8 oz / 227 g, approx. 45 hours burn time
Soy and coconut wax blend with a cotton wick
Scent notes: green fig, cedarwood, black tea, a trace of smoke
Reusable matte stoneware vessel, dishwasher safe once cleaned out
Trim wick to 5 mm before each burn
Hand-poured in Portland, Oregon

name: Tidewater Candle — Sea Salt, Driftwood & White Musk
description: A frosted sea-glass tumbler filled with a clean, airy scent: sea salt and driftwood up front, white musk and a little pale citrus underneath. It smells like a window left open on a bright morning, which makes it an easy one to burn in a bathroom or by the bed. Light enough to run every day without taking over a room.
details: 7 oz / 198 g, approx. 40 hours burn time
Soy wax with a cotton wick
Scent notes: sea salt, driftwood, white musk, pale grapefruit
Frosted glass tumbler with a bamboo lid
Keep away from drafts for an even burn
Hand-poured in Maine

name: Harlow Candle — Amber, Tobacco Leaf & Vetiver
description: A moody, grown-up candle in a fluted black glass vessel with a polished brass lid. Amber and tobacco leaf lead, with bergamot on top and a dry vetiver base that lingers after the flame is out. It sits well on a bar cart or a velvet-heavy living room, and the lid keeps the scent sealed between burns.
details: 10 oz / 283 g, approx. 55 hours burn time
Coconut and apricot wax blend, double cotton wick
Scent notes: amber, tobacco leaf, bergamot, vetiver, a touch of clove
Fluted glass vessel with a weighted brass lid
Vessel can be cleaned and reused as a stash jar
Hand-poured in Brooklyn, New York
imageQuery: black fluted glass candle brass lid

name: Hearth Candle — Woodsmoke, Clove & Dried Orange
description: A travel-sized soy candle in a lidded enamel tin, scented like a farmhouse kitchen in December: woodsmoke, clove and dried orange peel over a soft pine base. The cream tin with its dark green rim looks at home on a windowsill or a stack of cookbooks. It is small and sturdy enough to toss into a weekend bag.
details: 5 oz / 142 g, approx. 30 hours burn time
Soy wax with a cotton wick
Scent notes: woodsmoke, clove, dried orange peel, balsam pine
Enameled steel tin with a snap-fit lid
Do not burn for more than 3 hours at a time
Hand-poured in Vermont

name: Ilse Reed Diffuser — Bergamot, Hinoki & White Tea
description: A flame-free diffuser in a slim clear glass bottle with a pale oak collar and natural rattan reeds. The scent is spare and green: bergamot first, then the soft cedar-like warmth of hinoki wood and a clean white tea finish. It is the kind of scent that makes a hallway or bathroom feel freshly cleaned without smelling like soap.
details: 100 ml bottle, lasts approx. 3 months with 6 reeds
Fragrance oil in a plant-based carrier, alcohol free
Scent notes: bergamot, hinoki cypress, white tea, a hint of yuzu
Clear glass bottle with a solid oak collar and 8 rattan reeds
Flip the reeds weekly to refresh the throw
Blended in Kyoto, bottled in California

name: Kasbah Incense Set with Terracotta Holder
description: Hand-rolled incense sticks packed in a kraft box with a small hand-formed terracotta holder, the kind of thing that ends up on a stack of books next to a trailing plant. The sandalwood is creamy and slow, the palo santo sweet and resinous, and the cedar and sage blend dry and a little smoky. Each stick burns for about forty minutes and leaves a warm, collected feel in the room.
details: 40 sticks per box, approx. 40 minutes burn time each
Bamboo core rolled in natural resin, wood powder and essential oils
Unglazed terracotta holder included, 9 cm diameter
Sampler box contains 15 sticks each of sandalwood, palo santo and cedar & sage
Burn on a heat-safe surface in a ventilated room
Rolled in Jaipur, India

name: Nord Ash Vase
description: A tall, narrow-necked stoneware vase in a soft matte glaze that catches light the way chalk does. The silhouette is clean and slightly tapered, made to hold a single eucalyptus branch or three stems of dried grass without fuss. It is pale and quiet enough to sit on a white oak shelf and disappear until you notice it.
details: Small: 18 cm H x 9 cm W; Large: 28 cm H x 12 cm W
Stoneware with a matte food-safe glaze, watertight
Opening 3.5 cm, suits single branches and slim bunches
Hand-wash only
Made in Portugal

name: Juno Bud Vases (Set of 3)
description: Three small glazed stoneware bud vases in mustard, olive and teal, each a slightly different organic shape so they read as a family rather than a matching set. They line up on a windowsill or a walnut sideboard and look lived-in with a single sprig in each. The glazes are glossy and a little pooled at the base, which is where the hand-dipped character shows.
details: Heights 9 cm, 11 cm and 13 cm; openings 1.5–2.5 cm
Stoneware, hand-dipped in glossy glaze
Watertight, suited to fresh single stems
Hand-wash only; glaze variation is expected
Set of 3, gift boxed
Made in Portugal
imageQuery: ceramic bud vases set mustard olive

name: Sora Wabi Vase
description: A hand-thrown black stoneware vase with a low, wide belly and a raw unglazed band around the shoulder where the clay shows through. No two are quite alike; the throwing lines and the slight lean are left in rather than smoothed away. It holds one bare branch well and looks right on an oak console in a spare, calm entryway.
details: 22 cm H x 16 cm W at the belly; opening 5 cm
Black stoneware with a matte glaze and an unglazed raw band
Hand-thrown; expect variation in height and surface
Watertight; hand-wash only
Made in a family workshop in Mashiko, Japan

name: Odessa Fluted Vase
description: A tall ribbed glass vase in deep emerald with a polished brass band at the foot and the rim. The fluting runs vertically so it throws stripes of light across a table when a lamp is on nearby, and the weighted base keeps a full bunch of ranunculus steady. It is polished and a little theatrical, the piece you put at the center of a dinner table.
details: 30 cm H x 14 cm W; opening 10 cm
Mouth-blown fluted glass with brass-plated steel bands
Weighted base, approx. 1.6 kg
Hand-wash only; wipe brass dry after cleaning
Made in Poland

name: Solace Smoked Glass Vase
description: A chunky, bulbous vase in mouth-blown smoked glass that goes from amber at the rim to a deep tobacco brown at the base. The curve is round and heavy in the hand, with a short flared neck that suits a few stems of pampas or a loose bunch of dried wheat. It warms up a shelf next to a bouclé chair and looks straight out of a 1974 living room, in the good way.
details: 20 cm H x 18 cm W; opening 7 cm
Mouth-blown smoked glass; small bubbles are part of the process
Approx. 1.1 kg
Watertight; hand-wash only
Made in Portugal

name: Meadow Jug Vase
description: A pitcher-shaped stoneware vase in a cream glaze with a comfortable loop handle and a pulled spout. It looks like something off a farmhouse dresser and holds a big armful of wildflowers, cow parsley or a bundle of garden herbs by the sink. Homely and unfussy, and it works as an actual jug for water or lemonade too.
details: 24 cm H x 15 cm W; holds 1.4 L
Stoneware with a food-safe glaze
Dishwasher and microwave safe
Speckled oat glaze has visible iron flecks
Made in Portugal

name: Tierra Terracotta Planter
description: A classic unglazed terracotta pot with a matching saucer, thicker-walled than the garden-center kind and with a slightly rolled rim. The clay breathes, so roots stay healthy, and it picks up a soft patina of mineral bloom over time that only makes it look more collected. Line up three sizes on a balcony or cluster them by a sunny window with trailing pothos.
details: 15 cm, 20 cm and 28 cm diameters; saucer included
Unglazed terracotta, fired at high temperature
Drainage hole in the base
Frost resistant to -5°C; bring indoors in hard winters
Made in Tuscany, Italy

name: Foundry Concrete Planter
description: A straight-sided cylinder cast in fiber-reinforced concrete, left raw with the pour marks and tiny air pockets showing. It has a utilitarian, loft-floor look that suits a snake plant or a rubber tree beside a steel-framed shelf. Heavier than ceramic at the same size, which keeps tall plants from tipping.
details: 20 cm: 20 cm dia x 19 cm H, 2.4 kg; 30 cm: 30 cm dia x 28 cm H, 5.8 kg
Fiber-reinforced concrete, sealed inside
Drainage hole with a rubber plug for indoor use
Suitable for covered outdoor spaces
Cast in Ohio, USA

name: Cove Hanging Rattan Planter
description: A loosely woven rattan basket on a thick twisted cotton rope, with a removable plastic liner so you can hang a real pot inside without drips. The weave is open and sun-bleached in the whitewash finish, breezy and textured in the natural. It makes a trailing string-of-hearts look like it belongs in a light-filled corner or a bathroom with a skylight.
details: Basket 22 cm dia x 16 cm H; hangs 70 cm from the hook
Hand-woven rattan with a cotton rope hanger and brass hook
Removable waterproof liner included; fits pots up to 18 cm
Holds up to 4 kg
Woven in Indonesia

name: Linden Planter with Stand
description: A glossy glazed ceramic pot set into a solid walnut stand with three gently tapered legs, lifting the plant about 20 cm off the floor. It gives a fiddle-leaf fig or a bird of paradise the low-slung, organic look of a 1960s living room, and the stand keeps the pot off cold floors. The white glaze is the quiet option; olive and mustard are for people who already own a teal sofa.
details: Pot 25 cm dia x 23 cm H; overall height 43 cm with stand
Solid walnut stand with an oiled finish
Glazed stoneware pot with a drainage hole and saucer
Stand holds up to 15 kg
Simple assembly, legs screw in
Stand made in North Carolina; pot made in Portugal
imageQuery: mid century plant stand walnut ceramic pot

name: Bloom Glazed Planter
description: A squat stoneware planter with a wavy, scalloped rim and a high-gloss glaze in colors that do not apologize: cobalt, fuchsia or lime. It is playful and a bit loud on its own, and even better in a group of mismatched colors on a crowded shelf. Put a calathea in it and let the leaves clash.
details: 17 cm dia x 15 cm H; fits a 14 cm nursery pot
Stoneware with a glossy glaze
Drainage hole with a matching saucer included
Hand-wash only
Made in Portugal

name: Tempo Wall Clock
description: A round wall clock with a solid walnut case, a cream face with slim brass hour markers and tapered brass hands. The silent sweep movement means no ticking in a home office or a bedroom. It is low-key and warm, the sort of clock that looks right above a walnut credenza with a mustard lamp beside it.
details: 30 cm diameter x 5 cm deep
Solid walnut case with an oiled finish, domed glass lens
Quartz silent sweep movement, runs on 1 AA battery (included)
Keyhole hanger on the back
Made in Vietnam

name: Gantry Wall Clock
description: An oversized open-face wall clock made from a ring of blackened steel with the numerals cut out and the hands and movement left exposed, so the wall shows through. It reads from across a loft or a long kitchen and has the raw, workshop look of a factory clock without the weight. Rivets and finish marks are left visible.
details: 40 cm or 60 cm diameter, 4 cm deep
Laser-cut steel with a blackened or raw waxed finish
Quartz silent sweep movement, 1 AA battery (included)
Wall mount with a single screw; hardware included
Made in Poland
imageQuery: black steel skeleton wall clock industrial

name: Lumen Mantel Clock
description: A small mantel clock with a fluted brass case standing on a slab of white marble, the face a deep black enamel with gold batons. It is geometric and polished, built to catch lamplight on a mantel or a nightstand, and it is heavier than it looks. The kind of gift that gets kept for decades.
details: 18 cm H x 14 cm W x 7 cm D; approx. 1.9 kg
Brass-plated fluted zinc case on a solid marble base
Quartz silent sweep movement, 1 AA battery (included)
Marble veining varies; no two bases match
Gift boxed
Assembled in Portugal
imageQuery: brass marble mantel clock art deco

name: Marrakech Seagrass Baskets (Set of 3)
description: Three nesting baskets handwoven from seagrass and palm leaf with sturdy wrapped handles, in natural tones with an optional black chevron woven through. They are soft-sided but hold their shape, and the biggest one takes a full load of laundry or a large floor plant. Stacked in a corner or scattered through a layered living room, they add the warm, collected texture that makes a space feel settled.
details: Large 40 cm dia x 36 cm H; medium 33 x 30 cm; small 26 x 24 cm
Handwoven seagrass and palm leaf, no dye in the natural version
Wrapped palm handles
Spot clean with a damp cloth; keep dry
Woven by a fair-trade cooperative in Morocco

name: Halden Felt Storage Bins (Set of 2)
description: Two cube bins in thick pressed wool felt, pale grey with blind-stitched seams and a soft structure that stands up on its own but folds flat when empty. They slide into a shelving cube or sit on the floor of a nursery holding blocks, cables or spare bedding. Quiet, soft and easy to live with, in a way that plastic bins never are.
details: 28 cm W x 28 cm D x 28 cm H each
4 mm pressed wool-blend felt, 60% wool / 40% recycled polyester
Folds flat for storage
Spot clean only
Set of 2
Made in Lithuania

name: Dockside Rope Basket
description: A wide, low basket coiled from thick cotton rope and stitched with a single soft blue stripe near the rim, with two generous rope handles. It is light and airy, holds a pile of throws by the sofa or towels in a bathroom, and takes being dragged around a beach house without complaint. Machine washable, which is rare for a basket this size.
details: 45 cm dia x 30 cm H
100% cotton rope, coiled and stitched
Two integrated rope handles
Machine wash cold, reshape while damp
Made in India

name: Fenwick Wire Crate
description: A stackable storage crate in black powder-coated steel wire with a lid of reclaimed pine planks that doubles as a shelf for the crate above. The wire shows what is inside, so it works for pantry overflow, firewood kindling or boots by the door. Raw and practical, with the pine softening the steel just enough to sit in a farmhouse kitchen or a loft.
details: 45 cm W x 30 cm D x 28 cm H
Powder-coated steel wire frame, 4 mm gauge
Reclaimed pine lid with a brushed wax finish
Stacks up to 3 high; holds up to 20 kg
Wipe clean
Made in Portugal

name: Groove Storage Pouf
description: A round, chunky pouf upholstered in nubby bouclé with a lift-off lid and a deep hollow underneath for blankets, board games or the things you do not want on show. The curved shape and the burnt orange color are pure 1970s, warm and a little groovy, and it works as a footstool or an extra seat when people come over. Cream and chocolate are the quieter options.
details: 45 cm dia x 40 cm H; storage cavity 38 cm dia x 28 cm deep
Bouclé upholstery, 70% polyester / 30% wool, over a pine frame
High-density foam seat, holds up to 120 kg
Lid lifts off; no hinge
Spot clean only
Upholstered in Portugal
